name: wmkf_appreviewanswer-multiselect
_comment: Additive historical snapshot storage for runtime-configured multiselect review answers. The application stores canonical compact JSON [{value,label}] pairs; legacy answer rows leave this property null.

attributes.description: Canonical compact JSON array of ordered {value,label} pairs for multiselect answers. Null for picklist, richtext, and string answers; [] represents an allowed empty multiselect selection.
